communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: SLIC
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Email and email attachments between Delegate Mark Edelson (House of Delegates, District 46), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Delegate Todd Morgan (House of Delegates, District 26), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Benjamin Kramer (Senate, District 19), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Shelly Hettleman (Senate, District 11), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Delegate Mark Edelson (House of Delegates, District 46), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Delegate Todd Morgan (House of Delegates, District 26), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Benjamin Kramer (Senate, District 19), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Shelly Hettleman (Senate, District 11), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Calendar entries, meeting invitations, and scheduling records for Delegate Mark Edelson (House of Delegates, District 46); Delegate Todd Morgan (House of Delegates, District 26); Senator Benjamin Kramer (Senate, District 19); Senator Shelly Hettleman (Senate, District 11) concerning the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" / "50 States, One Nation" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Records of travel, lodging, or expenses paid for, reimbursed to, or arranged for Delegate Mark Edelson (House of Delegates, District 46); Delegate Todd Morgan (House of Delegates, District 26); Senator Benjamin Kramer (Senate, District 19); Senator Shelly Hettleman (Senate, District 11) in connection with the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request, including reimbursement forms, expense reports, and travel or gift disclosures.

- Records identifying the source of funding for the participation of Delegate Mark Edelson (House of Delegates, District 46); Delegate Todd Morgan (House of Delegates, District 26); Senator Benjamin Kramer (Senate, District 19); Senator Shelly Hettleman (Senate, District 11) in the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
